note: DBS's guide to the Credit Bureau Singapore report: repayment history counts on a 12-month rolling basis, written as one year (a default, a further listing the game doesn't model, shows three years once settled). MoneySense, the government's page, answers with CloudFront's block, and the bureau's own pages give nothing at the addresses tried, so the bank's guide is registered as secondary. No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: DBS, Understanding credit scores and why they matter
sources.said: Your account repayment history is kept on a 12-month rolling basis, for your credit score calculation. ... Default records with the status of “negotiated” or “full settlement” will be displayed for 3 years.
